home.intro: A starter storefront rendering live data from the Store API. Every brand app is generated from this template and overrides tokens, slots and route files — never the shared kit.

offline.title: Store API not reachable
offline.body: The storefront could not load GET /store. Start the Prism mock with `pnpm mock` (or the whole stack with `pnpm dev`) and reload.
offline.config: The client reads STORE_API_URL, falling back to MOCK_API_URL and then http://localhost:4010.

plp.empty: No products match these filters. Try clearing the search or choosing another category.
plp.metaDescription: Browse the full catalogue: filter by category, search, and sort by price or newest.

pdp.chooseOption: Choose an option before adding to the cart.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.summary: {average} out of 5, from {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}

cart.title: Cart

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.body: Nothing here yet — have a look at what is in stock.

cart.expired: Your cart has expired. Please start again.

shipping.title: How should it get there?
shipping.none: No delivery options are available for this address. Go back and check the address.

payment.title: How would you like to pay?
payment.manualBody: The order is placed now; payment is arranged separately with the shop.
payment.failed: Payment was not authorised. Choose a payment method and try again.
payment.cardBody: Enter your card on the next step. Card details go straight to our payment provider, Stripe — never to this shop.
payment.none: No payment method is available for this shop right now. Please contact us to complete your order.

review.title: Review your order
review.idempotencyNote: Placing the order sends an idempotency key, so a retry after a network error cannot create a second order.
review.cardNote: Placing the order checks your card and reserves the amount; your card is charged once the shop confirms the order. Card details go straight to Stripe — never to this shop.
review.cardFailed: Your card was not authorised. Please check the details or try another card.
review.cardUnavailable: Card payment is not available right now.
review.priceChanged: A price changed since you reviewed your order. Please check the new total and place it again.
review.threeDSecureAbandoned: The card check with your bank was not completed, so nothing was charged and your order was not placed. Your cart is unchanged — you can try again.

confirmation.title: Thank you
confirmation.unavailableBody: This order can only be shown to whoever placed it. Sign in to see the orders in your account.
confirmation.followSignedIn: You can follow its status in your account:
confirmation.followGuest: Please keep your order number, #{order} — you will need it if you contact us about this order.

bodyByStatus.pending: Order #{order} has been placed and is being processed.
bodyByStatus.confirmed: Order #{order} has been placed and is being processed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
